verdict.rationale: Base44 documents an official SDK for building your own frontend or backend on Base44 as a backend service. The docs include a getting-started overview, an entities CRUD module, and a concrete code example (base44.entities.Task.create). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use, documentation of SDK language coverage beyond the single JavaScript example, and evidence of SDK modules beyond entities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
